name: Kogen Studio
description: Product direction and lifecycle coordination around the Kogen software feature workflow. An identity website; no Studio application is implemented.
about: Kogen Studio is the wider product-development system around Kogen’s bounded software feature workflow. Its product direction concerns preserving durable product context and coordinating the lifecycle before and after a feature is shaped, approved and built. Kogen owns Shape → Approve → Build → Commit; Studio does not recreate or overrule that loop.

This website is an identity and reference surface. No Studio application is implemented, and this page is not a sign-up, software download or hosted Studio interface. The workbench image identifies the project. Follow Kogen for its current public introduction, source and announcements; do not infer Studio availability from the existence of this domain.
